title: The Biriyani Pack
description: Transforms bland Minecraft foods into an Indian feast, from biriyani to traditional sweets and drinks! This mod adds many indian foods to the game.
body:
This Minecraft resource pack adds a flavorful twist to your culinary adventures in the game! If you've ever wished your cooked meats could be a little more exciting, this pack is for you. It replaces the standard cooked meats like pork, steak, rabbit, chicken, mutton, and more, with vibrant, mouth-watering plates of _biriyani_. Now, instead of just a regular cooked pork chop, you'll feast on _pork biriyani_, complete with a spiced rice base, tender pieces of meat, and a colorful array of herbs and garnishes.

Each type of meat has its own unique biriyani version, like _beef biriyani, chicken biriyani, lamb biriyani_, and more, giving your Minecraft meals a whole new look and feel. Whether you’re hunting for food in the wild or cooking up a feast in your furnace, this resource pack brings a rich, exotic culinary experience to your gameplay. All textures are sourced from public‑domain, Adobe‑licensed stock photos, and no AI was used in their creation. It’s a fun way to add some variety to the foods you collect, all while maintaining the simplicity and charm of the classic Minecraft aesthetic.

Whether you're in survival mode or hosting a creative feast, this resource pack will spice up your world one plate at a time! Perfect for food lovers or anyone looking to add a bit of beautiful Indian culture and flavor to their Minecraft experience.
